title: Uniformity of application and construction.
bodyText: In applying and construing this chapter, consideration shall be given to the need to promote uniformity of the law with respect to its subject matter among states that enact it.
bodyHtml:
PART XI.  MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS

 

     [§554D-1101]  Uniformity of application and construction.  In applying and construing this chapter, consideration shall be given to the need to promote uniformity of the law with respect to its subject matter among states that enact it. [L 2021, c 32, pt of §2]
